title: Equilibrium (Le Chatelier)
goal: Put a sealed tube of brown nitrogen dioxide in a water bath. Predict how its colour changes.
intro: This sealed tube holds brown nitrogen dioxide and colourless dinitrogen tetroxide. They sit in equilibrium, a steady balance between the two. Pick a water bath, then predict the colour.

prediction.question: In the water bath, the gas will turn…

safety: Nitrogen dioxide is poisonous, so the tubes stay sealed. Only your teacher handles them, in a fume cupboard that pulls fumes away.
